review_method: Independent reread of exact frozen law and original already-moving witness after construction and before readiness gate; checked emergency/regulatory identity, moving and visible preparing alternatives, qualifying flashing equipment, officer exception, qualitative caution, and absence of a legal numeric cutoff or separate passing duty.
selected_branch_activation_to_prove: An approaching driver and a qualifying authorized emergency or official regulatory vehicle that is moving or visibly preparing with qualifying flashing lights; officer direction separately reviewed.
